provenance.model_training: No new VAE training. Frozen checkpoints and unchanged source splits.

real_data_audit.grouping: Destination IP and fixed 60-second wall-clock window; no label-based grouping
limitations: Identity-design denoising of scalar anomaly scores, not routed attack-amplitude recovery
Groups are evaluated after the complete window; this is not a causal online detector
Reused Monday validation was also used for VAE early stopping in Experiment 1
One fixed lab DDoS capture; not evidence for arbitrary real-world attacks

config.scenario_start: Independent copies of the same normal-trained state; causal updates within each stream
config.calibration: Independent normal stream, replayed and checked against Experiment 2
config.paper_independent: Full replay checked against the original cached estimates
